This is STRUCTURAL, not a failure: .github/workflows CI is triggered by `push: branches: [main]` and `pull_request: branches: [main]` only. A PR whose BASE is another feature branch matches neither trigger. Consequence for the run: every stacked PR from E2 through E7 will be NO-CHECKS by construction and will not be validated by CI until it is rebased onto main. The brief lists NO-CHECKS as a terminal state that releases the successor, so the stack is not blocked — but the morning report should say plainly that only #251 (base main) was actually exercised by CI. Local equivalents of both CI gates were run and are recorded in `lint` and `suite_result`.

deliberately_unchanged:
- OutputNormalizer.strip_phantom_images. Its absolute-URL passthrough
  (normalizer.py:227) is CORRECT for a provenance-blind normalizer, and two existing tests
  (test_preserves_http_urls, test_preserves_data_uris) assert exactly that contract. Changing
  it would have meant editing tests that assert the current behaviour in order to make a new
  one pass — the #250 shape. The new gate sits beside it and runs after it.
- Inline markdown links [label](url). Removing one deletes the label, which is real prose,
  and a URL mis-transcribed by one character is a corrupted reference, not an invented asset.
  An image ref is a pure pointer and carries no content of its own. A test asserts links
  survive on a PDF with no link annotations at all.
- Per-page status demotion on the phase-major lanes (single-engine / multi-engine / consensus
  / repair). They get the document-level sweep at assemble — refs removed, document flagged —
  but no individual PAGE status is demoted, because those lanes have no per-page seam at that
  point. Stated as a real gap in the PR body's surfacing table rather than papered over.
- Any network reachability check. Explicitly forbidden by the issue and by the threat model:
  a live attacker-controlled or coincidentally-registered URL is still fabricated.
- The alt text of a removed ref. It is a caption for a figure that does not exist; keeping it
  as prose would keep the fabrication while removing only its pointer. Preserved in the audit
  event for forensics.
- _winning_page_output / manifest.py — untouched again, same reasoning as E1.
